rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a physical back-and-forth flutter, including a lure or moving limb, rather than a fine trembling motion.

example.english: The constant flutter of the cloth flag by the window made my eyes go funny.
example.traditional: 窗邊條布旗不停擺動，睇到我眼都花。
example.jyutping: coeng1 bin1 tiu4 bou3 kei4 bat1 ting4 baai2 dung6 tai2 dou2 ngo5 ngaan5 dou1 faa1

rows.note: Use this for an episode of nervous or anticipatory excitement, not for the British betting use of “a flutter”.

example.english: While waiting for the results, I had a flutter of nervous excitement.
example.traditional: 等緊放榜嗰陣，我真係一陣心慌慌。
example.jyutping: dang2 gan2 fong3 bong2 go2 zan6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 jat1 zan6 sam1 fong1 fong1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the rapid eyelid or eyelash movement, especially when it is flirtatious.

example.english: They gave the camera a flirtatious flutter of their eyelashes.
example.traditional: 佢對住鏡頭眨眼，扮到好冧人咁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zyu6 geng3 tau4 zaam2 ngaan5 baan6 dou3 hou2 lam1 jan4 gam3
